messages:
alana: Quick thought — propose a tiny "jingle jar" for Friday: everyone drops a 5–10s voice clip or a cozy photo into a shared folder, we'll stitch them into a 2pm mini 'carol + bell' montage and play it on the hangout. also thinking a separate anonymous 'tiny kudos jar' for shoutouts :sparkles: 
devin: love this. count me in. can we do both voice and photo? :grin: 
sanjay: yes pls. i'll add a short clip of my dog barking the chorus. :dog: 
emily: omg that would be iconic. i'll drop a coffee-shelf pic. ☕️🎄 
noah: how do we upload? google drive link? permissions? 
alana: good Q — here's a simple plan: 1) drop files into this folder (oneDrive/Shared/holiday-jingle-jar) or DM me if you want anonymity for the kudos jar 2) filename format: first-last_clip or photo 3) deadline Thu 6pm so we can stitch on Fri morning. i'll post a sign-up sheet in a sec. :thumbsup:
linda: put me down for a 7s jingle. also down for anonymous kudos — got a teammate to call out. :heart:
devin: +1 on anon kudos. maybe small form so people can write 1 sentence? 
alana: yup — quick form: https://tiny.redwood/jingle-signup (placeholder) — pick clip/photo and check 'anon kudos' if you want to contribute a shoutout. i'll close submissions Thu 18:00 PST. 
calendar-bot: Event added: "Jingle Jar — 2pm Holiday Montage & Tiny Carols" on Fri at 14:00 to #all-hands (reminder 10m before). 
sanjay: can we have background music? not too loud. or just raw clips? 
emily: mellow background would be nice. maybe instrumental loop only under voices. 
noah: i'll help stitch — can take the morning edit slot. pls set highest bitrate for audio files if possible. 
alana: amazing — thanks noah! quick how-to for recording (if anyone's unsure):
```
- phone: voice memos, export mp3
- desktop: quicktime/record, File -> Export as MP3
- name file like: devin_jingle.mp3
```
devin: tagging @here — drop something fun even if it's 3s. tiny beats > none. :santa: :bell: 
linda: holiday sweater photo incoming. brace yourselves. :sweater:
emily: also pro tip: put your phone in landscape for group photos, looks nicer in the montage. 
alana: cool — i'll compile and post the final montage in this channel before 1:45 so folks can grab the link for the 2pm hangout. thanks y'all! :sparkles:
